notes.title: Update v1.2.0: Quality of Life Improvements and New Interactions
notes.content:
[quote]Hello, Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time players!

We are pleased to announce the arrival of update v1.2.0, filled with quality of life improvements and new features that will make your gaming experience even more exciting. Here are the full details:[/quote]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Fruit Retention:[/b] Now, when you die, you won't lose the fruits collected during that life. It's easier to accumulate fruits to spend in the power-ups store!
[*][b]Full Health Respawn:[/b] If you die without reaching any checkpoint, you will respawn with full health.
[*][b]New Checkpoints:[/b] We have added checkpoints in various long levels to facilitate your progress.
[*][b]Challenge Adjustments:[/b] Some challenges in different levels have been adjusted to be more achievable, such as collecting all the fruits.
[*][b]Visual and Environmental Improvements:[/b] Various visual and environmental fixes for a smoother experience.
[*][b]Dialogue Adjustments:[/b] Dialogues have been adjusted to better explain the use and function of power-ups.
[*][b]SFX Fixes:[/b] Fixed some sound effects that were not working properly.
[/list]

[b]New Interactions:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Interactive Objects:[/b] Footballs and basketballs, as well as rolling plants, can now be kicked, punched, and shot!
[/list]

[quote]Additionally, we are pleased to announce that the game's soundtrack, created by Jorge MS Music, is now available for purchase. All proceeds from the soundtrack sales will go directly to the artist as a special thank you for collaborating with us.

We hope you enjoy all the improvements and new features of update v1.2.0! As always, we appreciate your feedback and suggestions to continue improving Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time.

See you in the game![/quote]
